term: essential causal dependence: local transmission versus finite grounding
resolution: LocalTransmission constrains neighboring activities by equality; PowerTransmissionRule generalizes to immediate causes and an explicit cut-edge model, but admits more than one global fixed point on the successor chain. FinitelyGroundedPower, in contrast, is inductively generated by independent source power and finite actual transmission paths. Neither is automatically identical to Aquinas' per se efficient causal link. Showing that an actual per se chain requires the inductive rather than a greatest/coinductive or globally constrained solution remains an open, independently sourced metaphysical obligation. BRIDGE-PER-SE-REGRESS-FINITE-GROUNDING uses FinitelyGroundedPower over Aquinas' `CausesAsCaused` only as an inductive path structure, with 'intrinsic' read as 'has no per se cause upstream'; it identifies no power semantics with the per se link. It shows that the well-foundedness premise STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-SERIES, with excluded middle, makes every being finitely grounded in that structural sense; it does not discharge the open obligation above, which concerns causal power.
